description: This file provides a React hook and utility functions to perform progressive batching of work items, leveraging requestIdleCallback or setTimeout to avoid blocking the UI thread. It includes the core function createProgressiveExpandController and a React hook useProgressiveExpand to manage batch processing state.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller object to process items in batches asynchronously, using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout, with progress and cancellation support.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: React hook that manages UI state for progressive batch processing, utilizing createProgressiveExpandController internally.
